content:
IncidentBot: [PAGER] HIGH - model-redwood-2 (v3.2.1) quality regression + latency spike detected. SLO: token-latency and semantic-quality failing. Pager routed to on-call SREs.

Maya: On it. Investigating metrics now — pulling recent traces and golden prompts.

Maya: Quick summary from dashboards: 95th latency up ~3x for ~12% of requests since 02:12 UTC. Quality alert (eval-runner) shows sudden drop in QA-score on canary prompts starting 02:10.

Josh: Noted. We rolled v3.2.1 ~01:50 UTC to hosted cluster. Were there any kernel/quantization changes in that deploy?

Priya: v3.2.1 included new attention-kernel and an aggressive quantization pass for some transformer layers. We ran unit evals but not full regression suite on production prompt set.

Maya: Trace shows tail latency tied to KV-cache eviction pattern with the new kernel. Also some prompts show hallucination regressions. Correlating with requests that hit >2048 context.

Dan: Impact: customers on dedicated pools unaffected. Hosted API customers: approx 11k calls in 30m window, 1.3k affected with failures/quality degradation. No data exfil.

Emily: Need a status page blurb. Draft: "We are investigating increased latency and quality regressions affecting a subset of requests to model-redwood-2 (hosted). Engineers are actively triaging. We will provide updates every 30 minutes." Thoughts?

Amanda: Add customer note for top affected: "If you see degraded output quality from model-redwood-2, we recommend switching to model-redwood-1.9 or pinning to v3.2.0. Our team can assist with routing changes." I'll notify top 5 customers after we have mitigation plan.

Josh: From risk perspective, rollback to v3.2.0 seems clean and low-risk. We should also pin model-redwood-2 to v3.2.0 for hosted traffic while we investigate kernel/quant. Agree?

Priya: I agree — rollback first, deep dive second. Also capture a set of failing prompts and open a regression ticket with reproducible inputs.

Maya: Operational plan: 1) Initiate rollback to v3.2.0 (canary 10% -> 100%); 2) Pin model-redwood-2 to v3.2.0 for hosted; 3) Run full production prompt regression bench; 4) Postmortem.

Dan: I'll execute the rollback. Command for routing (internal):
```bash
# route config api
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://controlplane.redwood.internal/api/route --data '{"model":"model-redwood-2","target_version":"3.2.0","canary_percent":10}'
```

Dan: Starting canary now (10%). I'll post progress. ETA to 100% if stable: ~8-10 minutes.

Maya: Capturing canary logs and will watch golden prompts. Priya, please collect failing examples to /tmp/regressions/1799007777.txt and push to the ticket.

Priya: Copy — saving examples. Also scheduling a small eval run against the full prompt set (est ~25m).

Josh: Heads-up: if rollback triggers kernel mismatch errors in runtime, fallback policy should route to compatible variant. Ops, make sure runtime fallback is enabled.

Dan: Canary at 10% -> observing metrics. Latency down slightly on canary routes. No new quality alerts on canary nodes so far.

Maya: Good sign. If canary holds for 5m, ramp to 50%. Keep an eye for KV-cache errors in logs.

Emily: Status page update (v1): "We have initiated a rollback to model-redwood-2 v3.2.0 for hosted traffic. Canary at 10% showing improvement. We will update in 10 minutes." Anyone edit?

Amanda: Customer-facing short: "We detected a regression in the recent model update and are rolling back to the prior version. No action required; you may pin to v3.2.0 via the dashboard or contact support for assistance." Approve.

Dan: Ramp to 50% now.

Maya: Monitoring: 95th latency on routed traffic trending back toward baseline. Quality regression alerts cleared on canary. Still watching for errors on older sequences.

Josh: Can we capture the exact commit for v3.2.1 and the build artifact? Might need to repro locally.

Priya: v3.2.1 artifact: sha1: abc123ef45; build-id: 2026-03-15-0150. Saving to ticket and archiving failing prompt pairs.

Dan: Ramp to 100% — rollback complete. Routing now at v3.2.0 across hosted.

Maya: Confirming: latency and quality metrics back to normal based on current dashboards. Closing immediate mitigation window.

Emily: Status page update (v2): "SERVICE: Resolved — We rolled back model-redwood-2 to v3.2.0. Monitoring shows restored latency and quality for affected requests. Postmortem underway. If you continue to see issues, please contact support."

Amanda: Sending customer note now to top affected. Message includes recommendation to pin to v3.2.0 if they need to avoid automatic upgrades and offer 1:1 help.

Priya: Action items for postmortem: - regression test coverage gap analysis; - add production prompt set to pre-deploy checks; - revert quantization kernel or add compatibility tests; - reproduce locally with abc123ef45. I'll own the regression ticket.

Josh: Ops/playbook updates: add a preflight check that compares golden-eval against a baseline before promoting kernel/quant changes. I'll open a task.

Maya: Handoff: I'm going to compose a short on-call handoff for the night team. If anything flares, page SRE-night.

Maya: Handoff summary: "Rollback completed to v3.2.0 at 02:25 UTC. Monitoring green. Regression ticket created (#REG-1799). Priya leading root-cause. Follow-up: investigate KV-cache eviction interaction with new kernel. No customer data exposure."

Dan: Thanks — I'm closing the pager. Leaving alerts muted for 30m while metrics settle.

IncidentBot: Pager resolved by Dan at 1799008430.

Emily: Noted — drafting postmortem timeline now. Will share early draft in #postmortems tomorrow.

Amanda: I've emailed the affected customers and queued support tickets for hands-on routing help.

Maya: Great work everyone. We'll reconvene after initial RCA.

Priya: Pls remember to attach failing prompts and evaluation traces to the ticket. I'll tag runtime/infra teams.

Josh: I'll follow up on test harness improvements.

Dan: Closing thread.
